<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><lb xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4a4"/> 'gro phyogs thams cad<seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exS012025-02-1315-53-23" status="unreviewed">
         de nas <rs type="person" ref="db:3834" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">stod lung rgya dmar</rs> gyi sar rta sga <lb n="4a5"/> phog sa byas nas | <rs type="person" ref="db:7167" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dbas chen po</rs> ka ca che ba dang khyad med du spyad nas dpe cha la sogs pa thams cad khyad med du byas || dbu tshad rang brgyud nyan pa'i <rs type="person" ref="db:3837" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shar chos pa dge bshes g.yor nyan</rs> la zhus ||<!--[Then, [rDo rje rgyal po] rested his saddle on the ground at the place of sTod lung rgya dmar. And he treated his things, great or not, even texts and so forth, as non-different (i.e., shared) with dBas chen po. He requested Shar chos pa dGe bshes g.Yor nyan to hear his own lineage of teachings on dbu and tshad.]--></seg></TEI>
